svg.title: Deposit, Track, Reconcile, Then Scale
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-08-unit-economics-scale-roadmap; chapter number: 12; chart type: timeline_roadmap; title: Deposit, Track, Reconcile, Then Scale; subtitle: A four-step operating sequence for protecting the spread; caption: The payout rate alone never proves a deal is profitable; rejected calls, duplicates, callback fraud, telecom costs and buyer credit risk all eat into the spread.; assumptions note: Week labels group practitioner gates into an operating order; practitioners did not prescribe a four-week schedule. Thresholds are attributed claims from John Ventura, ceohec, Ringba, TrackDrive, ExclusiveLiveCall and Marketcall.; note: Sources: ceohec (SkS03nygdoY), Ringba (JxU9bgFTUUs), John Ventura (x3UYaJjRdx0, KeC4mKXnzs4), Marketcall (Dq9KUpYUWsE), TrackDrive (y8V08rKKNWY, yYZ5s6jFzQs), ExclusiveLiveCall (b7P50zcQzTs).; weeks: week: Week 1; title: Collect deposits and sign the paper; deliverable: $500 to $1,000 minimum buyer deposit up front; QA addendum with a 50% penalty per CPA for callback fraud; signed affiliate one-pager.; gate: Always get payments up front before routing a call (ceohec).; week: Week 2; title: Run tracked calls into a paid test; deliverable: Call tracker on every campaign; sell buyers a $2-5k test that reads out within 24-48 hours.; gate: No campaign runs without a call tracker (Marketcall).; week: Week 3; title: Reconcile and dispute with specifics; deliverable: Pay publishers only on qualified calls; open disputes with dated specifics such as 'between the third and the seventh'.; gate: When 15 of 100 calls are disputed, find out why; a buyer failing to close is not an invalid call.; week: Week 4; title: Scale only past the billable bar; deliverable: Billable rate at or above 50%, positive post-reconciliation margin, and clean QA.; gate: Add affiliates gradually and never 10 at once (John Ventura).
